units.title: Overview
units.goal: Sequence Microform tokenization with Payer Authentication enrollment, challenge or frictionless handling, validation, and authorization.
units.body_markdown: Microform tokenization captures card data in the browser. It is **not** itself a completed Payer Authentication / 3DS step. After tokenize, you still need enrollment and either challenge or frictionless handling before authorization.
evidence_quotes: Microform tokenization captures card data in the browser. It is **not** itself a completed Payer Authentication / 3DS step. After tokenize, you still need en...

units.title: Prerequisites
units.goal: Sequence Microform tokenization with Payer Authentication enrollment, challenge or frictionless handling, validation, and authorization.
units.body_markdown:
- Sandbox merchant credentials available as environment variables (never hardcode)
- Microform client integrated on the checkout page
- Payer Authentication enabled for the sandbox MID
evidence_quotes: - Sandbox merchant credentials available as environment variables (never hardcode) - Microform client integrated on the checkout page - Payer Authentication ...

units.title: Tokenize with Microform
units.goal: Sequence Microform tokenization with Payer Authentication enrollment, challenge or frictionless handling, validation, and authorization.
units.body_markdown:
Capture the payment fields with Microform and obtain a transient token.

Requires: microform_client
Outcome: transient_token_available
Evidence: "Microform tokenization captures card data in the browser."
evidence_quotes: Microform tokenization captures card data in the browser.

units.title: Run Payer Auth setup
units.goal: Sequence Microform tokenization with Payer Authentication enrollment, challenge or frictionless handling, validation, and authorization.
units.body_markdown:
Create the Payer Authentication setup request using the tokenized payment data.

Requires: transient_token_available
Outcome: payer_auth_setup_complete
Evidence: "After tokenize, you still need enrollment"
evidence_quotes: After tokenize, you still need enrollment

units.title: Check enrollment
units.goal: Sequence Microform tokenization with Payer Authentication enrollment, challenge or frictionless handling, validation, and authorization.
units.body_markdown:
Call enrollment check. Expect FRICTIONLESS, CHALLENGE, or UNAVAILABLE.

Requires: payer_auth_setup_complete
Outcome: enrollment_path_known
Failure modes: skipping enrollment and authorizing immediately
Evidence: "Expect FRICTIONLESS, CHALLENGE, or UNAVAILABLE"

units.title: Handle challenge or frictionless
units.goal: Sequence Microform tokenization with Payer Authentication enrollment, challenge or frictionless handling, validation, and authorization.
units.body_markdown:
Branch on the enrollment path. Do not collapse both into one success branch.

Requires: enrollment_path_known
Outcome: authentication_result_ready
Evidence: "Branch on the enrollment path"

units.title: Validate authentication
units.goal: Sequence Microform tokenization with Payer Authentication enrollment, challenge or frictionless handling, validation, and authorization.
units.body_markdown:
Validate the authentication result before payment.

Requires: authentication_result_ready
Outcome: auth_refs_ready
Evidence: "Validate the authentication result before payment"
evidence_quotes: Validate the authentication result before payment

units.title: Authorize with authentication references
units.goal: Sequence Microform tokenization with Payer Authentication enrollment, challenge or frictionless handling, validation, and authorization.
units.body_markdown:
Submit authorization including authentication transaction references when 3DS was performed.

Requires: auth_refs_ready
Outcome: authorization_submitted
Failure modes: authorizing with only the Flex/Microform token and no auth refs
Evidence: "including authentication transaction references when 3DS was performed"
failure_modes: authorizing with only the Flex/Microform token and no auth refs
evidence_quotes: including authentication transaction references when 3DS was performed

units.title: Validation checks
units.goal: Sequence Microform tokenization with Payer Authentication enrollment, challenge or frictionless handling, validation, and authorization.
units.body_markdown:
- Confirm enrollment ran before authorization
- Confirm challenge and frictionless paths are both handled
- Confirm authorization carries authentication references when required
evidence_quotes: - Confirm enrollment ran before authorization - Confirm challenge and frictionless paths are both handled - Confirm authorization carries authentication refe...

units.title: Warnings
units.goal: Sequence Microform tokenization with Payer Authentication enrollment, challenge or frictionless handling, validation, and authorization.
units.body_markdown:
- Do not treat Microform tokenize as completed 3DS
- Do not log raw PAN, shared secrets, or credential material
evidence_quotes: - Do not treat Microform tokenize as completed 3DS - Do not log raw PAN, shared secrets, or credential material
